title: Grok Bot just got its own email address, here’s how to claim yours
key_facts: Grok Bot has its own email address, the second significant upgrade this week.
Announcement on X: Bot can use it to sign up for services, contact businesses for you, or schedule time with someone.
Rolling out to users on the day; ask Bot or tag @bot on X to claim an inbox; a custom address can be requested and checked for availability.
Addresses end @mail.grokbot.com and are used by the agent system.
Earlier this week Grok Bot got an intelligence upgrade with the help of Anthropic's Claude.
9to5Mac sets it beside Meta's Muse (now on iPad) and OpenAI's ChatGPT Dot, an Astra-powered proactive agent.
quote_evidence: “Bot can use it to sign up for services, contact businesses for you, or schedule time with someone,” per the announcement on X.
“Rolling out to users today. To claim your inbox, just ask Bot or tag @bot on X,” the announcement explains.
The Grok Bot email will end with @mail.grokbot.com and be used by the agent system.
why_it_matters_hint: An agent with its own email can act for a person with outside businesses.
notes: How-to style article; no detail on safeguards or limits. Owner described as SpaceX as in our 8 Oct 2026 edition (Gizmodo).
